day_shape: 75 items: Trump-ordered pause on 13-day US strike campaign holds into a second night, Khamenei publishes multi-part response to Hezbollah loyalty letter, Iran-Ukraine escalation over Caspian ship strike, IRGC-linked Tasnim claims Strait of Hormuz tanker mine blast, nothing from UK Parliament or IAEA.

threads.label: US strike pause and Trump posture
threads.summary: Iran International and Jerusalem Post report a second night without US strikes after Trump halted a 13-day bombing campaign, with Trump denying munitions-shortage explanations and posting AI-generated images of Iranian ships being destroyed. A senior Iranian source told Reuters Tehran will hold fire while the US pause continues, and Arab media reported both sides submitted responses to a Pakistani-Qatari talks proposal.

threads.label: Khamenei response to Hezbollah loyalty letter
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a multi-post response to a letter of allegiance from Hezbollah's Secretary General and fighters, praising Nasrallah and calling steadfastness in resistance the path to divine victory. The office said the Islamic Republic has designated defence of Lebanon's fighters as strategic policy; Jerusalem Post reported statements attributed to Mojtaba Khamenei calling for continued jihadist attacks on Israel and the US.

threads.label: Iran-Ukraine confrontation over Caspian ship
threads.summary: Foreign Minister Araghchi accused Zelensky of attacking an Iranian commercial vessel and killing a sailor, calling it a UN Charter violation done at Israel's behest, while Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri said Ukraine's actions will not go unanswered. Ukraine's ambassador to Israel said the struck ship carried drone and missile components bound for Iran; IRIB relayed a Russian MoD claim of drone strikes on two cargo ships at Mykolaiv.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea shipping
threads.summary: IRGC-linked Tasnim reported an oil tanker exploded in the Strait of Hormuz after hitting a naval mine, while Kpler data cited by Jerusalem Post showed only eleven commodity vessels passed Bab el-Mandeb on Sunday, the lowest in months. Defa Press quoted Commander Sanairad claiming the US-called ceasefire was cover for an Iranian operation to seize the Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM posted imagery of USS Mason resupply in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Iranian official messaging and Mersad anniversary
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesman Bagheri told IRIB the US bears sole responsibility for the current situation, said France must apologise to Iran, and declared there is currently no ceasefire. The Army, Ground Force commander Jahansahi and Defa Press marked the Operation Mersad anniversary with statements that any aggression will meet a severe and more forceful response.

threads.label: Gaza and Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF announced the killing of Hamam Eid, commander of Hamas's UAV cell in Gaza's central camps, in a strike the previous day, and Jerusalem Post reported an airstrike killed a senior Hamas-run internal security officer near Deir al-Balah. Army Radio reported the IDF shot down a Hezbollah intelligence-gathering drone over the Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Iran sanctions evasion and regime-change discourse
threads.summary: Iran International reported officials acknowledged intermediaries misappropriated at least $1.6 billion from Iran's sanctions-evasion oil-revenue network, and Jerusalem Post reported the UK's Islamic Center of England was granted skilled-worker visa sponsorship despite alleged regime ties. World Jewish Congress Israel's Sylvan Adams met Reza Pahlavi in Paris; Netanyahu said the war ends when the regime falls or abandons its nuclear programme.

events.title: Iran's Alamut Castle inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage site
events.summary: UNESCO added Iran's Alamut Castle and related fortifications to its World Heritage List on Sunday, making it the country's 30th tangible cultural heritage site to receive the designation.
